children: Quantum X announced its corporate name change and trading symbol update; shares now trade as QUTX on the OTC market.
FINRA completed review and announced the name change and symbol change from TWOH to QUTX on Sept. 11, 2026.
The Name Change and Symbol Change became effective in the over-the-counter market at the open of trading on Sept. 14, 2026.
Stockholders need take no action; outstanding certificates in the former name remain valid and do not require exchange.
The changes do not affect the rights of the Company’s stockholders.
